title: Logbook event, version 1
description: The public shape of one event (function F-C01), in --json and the AI interface. Changing it needs a new version (schema/event-v2.schema.json). Rules beyond this schema, enforced by the model: a real calendar date and time; end and last_time not before time; last_time only when count > 1; raw_omitted only when count > 1.

id.description: Stable ID (F-C12): SHA-256 of the reader, the record's position (not its text) and the event's part number within the record.

time.description: When it happened (for folded events: the first time), UTC, exactly 6 decimal places, so text order is time order.

last_time.description: For folded events (count > 1): the last time (F-C03); else null. Not before time.

end.description: End of a duration (e.g. microphone use); else null. Not before time.

utc_offset.description: Seconds east of UTC where it happened (F-A08: local time while travelling).

template.description: The text template that wrote the summary (F-C10, G8).

source_kind.description: Where the subject comes from (F-C09); none for subjects that aren't programs, such as a device.

package.description: The package or app ID it belongs to (F-C09).

path.description: The program's path, as the source reported it.

summary.description: One sentence in plain words (F-C10): no line breaks or control characters, no spaces at the ends.

details.description: Structured details per kind. Each kind gets its own details schema in the step that creates it.

reason.description: Why it is linked, in plain words (F-C06).

strength.description: Weak links are marked as such (F-C06).

raw.description: Up to 20 original lines (F-D03). Bytes that aren't valid UTF-8 are replaced by U+FFFD, and raw_lossy says so.

raw_omitted.description: How many original lines were left out (folded events with more than 20).

raw_lossy.description: True if a raw line had bytes that aren't valid UTF-8.

rules_version.description: Version of the rules it was derived with; older ones show as derived with an older version (F-C12).
